in_tamil.name: போஜ்

in_telugu.name: భోజ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who feeds others or cooks food for them

in_marathi.name: Bhoj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhoj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who offers, a giver, a feeder. Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘bhu’ meaning ‘to feed’ and ‘j’ meaning ‘giver’ or ‘offering’. In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is referred to as Bhoj, the one who feeds and nourishes all living beings.

Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘bhu’ meaning ‘to feed’ and ‘j’ meaning ‘giver’ or ‘offering’. In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is referred to as Bhoj, the one who feeds and nourishes all living beings.
